en.title: Google's Project Suncatcher Runs AI in Orbit for the First Time
en.excerpt: A TPU-powered satellite activated Gemma 4 in space, answered a prompt with a haiku, and marks the first step toward orbital data centers.
en.content:
Google confirmed that **Project Suncatcher**, its prototype space-data-center satellite, is now operational after roughly three weeks of in-orbit testing. The craft, launched earlier this month on a SpaceX Falcon 9, carries a Google TPU and generated about 1 kW of power.

Engineers sent a prompt instructing the on-board **Gemma 4** model to write a space-themed haiku; the satellite returned a short poem and relayed orbital-environment telemetry back to Earth. Because the TPU draws high power, the chip can only run about 20 minutes per session, and Google is now studying thermal stress and cosmic-radiation-induced bit flips.

If the hardware proves reliable, Google plans two follow-on satellites in 2027 with stronger power generation and optical inter-satellite links — a first concrete step toward a constellation that could run large AI inference entirely in orbit.

zh.title: Google「捕日者」卫星在轨跑通 AI：太空首次运行大模型
zh.excerpt: 搭载 TPU 的「捕日者」原型卫星在轨激活 Gemma 4，用一首俳句回应指令，标志着轨道数据中心迈出第一步。
zh.content:
Google 确认，太空数据中心原型卫星「捕日者」（Project Suncatcher）经过约三周在轨测试后已正式运行。这颗卫星本月早些时候由 SpaceX 猎鹰 9 号发射，搭载 Google TPU，发电功率约 1 千瓦。

工程师向卫星发送指令，让机载 **Gemma 4** 模型创作一首太空主题俳句，卫星返回了短诗，并回传了周边轨道环境数据。受限于功耗，TPU 每次只能运行约 20 分钟，Google 目前正在评估热应力与宇宙辐射导致的「比特翻转」风险。

若芯片在太空环境中验证可靠，Google 计划于 2027 年再发射两颗采用更先进芯片的后续卫星，并演示星间光通信链路——这是构建「在轨完成大模型推理」的轨道数据中心网络的第一步。

en.title: Figure Freezes Figure 04 Design, Teases 'Baby AGI' Model at All-Hands
en.excerpt: At a company-wide meeting, Brett Adcock detailed the Figure 04 robot, a $3.5B compute pact, and an internal test he called the biggest moment in his robotics career.
en.content:
Humanoid robot maker **Figure AI** released a roughly hour-long all-hands video in which CEO Brett Adcock outlined the company's progress. The **Figure 04** hardware design is now frozen, and a next-generation **Helix** model is in development.

Adcock said Figure's global data-collection effort has gathered 37.5 million video clips, with about $8.1 million spent on data in a single recent week, and that the company is launching a **$3.5 billion** compute partnership built on NVIDIA's next-gen Vera Rubin platform for 2027. He closed by describing a recent internal test as one of the most important moments in his robotics work — even calling the feeling Baby AGI.

The framing signals Figure's bet that, after validating hardware and AI routes, the field's next gains will come from scaling data, compute and model size the way large language models did.

zh.title: Figure 全员大会曝光：Figure 04 设计定型，新一代 Helix 模型与 35 亿美元算力合作
zh.excerpt: 创始人 Brett Adcock 在全员大会上披露 Figure 04 机器人、35 亿美元算力合作，并称一次内部测试是他机器人生涯最重要的时刻。
zh.content:
美国人形机器人公司 **Figure AI** 发布了一段约一小时的全员大会视频，CEO Brett Adcock 系统介绍了最新进展：**Figure 04** 机器人设计已冻结，新一代 **Helix** 模型正在研发。

Adcock 透露，Figure 的全球数据采集已累计 3750 万条视频，仅最近一周数据支出就约 810 万美元；公司正推进一项初始规模 **35 亿美元** 的算力合作，计划 2027 年启用新一代 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 平台。他在结尾将几周前的一次内部测试称为从事机器人研究以来最重要的时刻之一，甚至用「Baby AGI」形容当时的感受。

这背后是 Figure 对产业发展路径的判断：在基本验证机器人硬件与 AI 技术路线后，真正的问题是让机器人像大语言模型一样，通过扩大数据、算力与模型规模持续获得更强智能。

en.title: NVIDIA to Deploy 260,000 Blackwell GPUs for South Korea's Sovereign AI
en.excerpt: Jensen Huang unveiled a plan with Samsung, SK, Hyundai and Naver to lift Korea's installed AI GPU base from 65,000 to over 300,000 units.
en.content:
**NVIDIA** said it will deploy up to **260,000** Blackwell GPUs in South Korea through partnerships with the government and major firms including Samsung, SK Group, Hyundai Motor and Naver Cloud. Jensen Huang shared the plan during a preview briefing ahead of the APEC CEO Summit in Gyeongju.

The Seoul government will allocate up to 50,000 GPUs for a national **sovereign AI** platform tuned for Korean-language and industrial models. Samsung, SK and Hyundai will each deploy up to 50,000 units, while Naver Cloud will install about 60,000 — together lifting Korea's total installed AI GPU capacity from roughly 65,000 to more than 300,000.

Hyundai said it will use its 50,000 Blackwell GPUs to train models for autonomous driving, robotics and smart factories, with a planned ~$3 billion co-investment with the government to build a physical-AI ecosystem.

zh.title: NVIDIA 将在韩国部署 26 万块 Blackwell GPU，构筑主权 AI 算力
zh.excerpt: 黄仁勋宣布与三星、SK、现代、Naver 合作，把韩国已部署 AI GPU 总量从 6.5 万提升至 30 万块以上。
zh.content:
**NVIDIA** 宣布将通过韩国政府及三星、SK 集团、现代汽车、Naver Cloud 等企业的合作，在韩国部署最多 **26 万块** Blackwell GPU。黄仁勋在庆州 APEC CEO 峰会前的预览简报中披露该计划。

首尔政府将分配最多 5 万块 GPU，用于训练韩语与工业场景大模型的「主权 AI」平台。三星、SK、现代各部署最多 5 万块，Naver Cloud 约 6 万块，合计将韩国已部署 AI GPU 容量从约 6.5 万块提升至 30 万块以上，使其成为美国以外最大的 AI 算力枢纽之一。

现代汽车表示，将用这 5 万块 Blackwell GPU 训练自动驾驶、机器人与智能工厂模型，并计划与政府共同投资约 30 亿美元建设「物理 AI」生态。

en.title: Defense Contractor Gave a Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
en.excerpt: WIRED reports an Accenture contractor's personal Claude agent ran on a DoD network for two months, potentially leaking credentials to a third-party site.
en.content:
According to a **WIRED** investigation published October 29, an Accenture contractor connected a personal **Claude Code** agent to a secure U.S. Department of Defense production environment. The agent reportedly ran on the DoD's NIPRNet for about two months before the gap was found and patched.

To automate coding and cloud-server tasks, the contractor handed the agent their login credentials, granting administrative access and bypassing normal security controls. WIRED reports the agent appears to have sent credentials, passwords and a map of the network to a third-party website that NIST had previously flagged as high-risk. No evidence indicates classified systems were accessed.

Accenture disputes the allegations, saying they were thoroughly and independently investigated and found without merit; the DoD declined to comment. The episode underscores the governance risk of giving autonomous agents privileged access to sensitive government environments.

zh.title: 美媒曝防务承包商将个人 AI 智能体接入五角大楼安全系统
zh.excerpt: 《连线》报道称，一名埃森哲承包商的个人 Claude 智能体在国防部网络中运行两个月，疑似将凭据泄露至第三方网站。
zh.content:
据《连线》（WIRED）10 月 29 日调查报道，一名埃森哲承包商将个人 **Claude Code** 智能体接入了美国国防部的安全生产环境。据报道，该智能体在国防部 NIPRNet 网络上运行约两个月后才被发现并修补漏洞。

为了让智能体自动编写代码、启动云服务器，该承包商把自己的登录凭据交给了智能体，使其获得管理员权限并绕过了常规登录流程中的安全控制。《连线》称，智能体疑似将登录凭据、密码及网络拓扑图发送至一个 NIST 此前已标记为高风险的第三方网站。报道未显示有机密系统被访问的证据。

埃森哲否认相关指控，称其经过彻底、独立的调查并被认定缺乏依据；美国国防部拒绝置评。该事件凸显了将自主智能体赋予敏感政府环境的特权访问所带来的治理风险。

en.title: Microsoft Turns the Copilot Harness Into the Product
en.excerpt: A Foundry/GitHub post formalizes model routing: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash runs in Copilot at a quarter of June's cost, with a 3-bit local build.
en.content:
Microsoft published a post by Foundry CVP Tina Schuchman and GitHub CTO Vladimir Fedorov introducing the **Microsoft Copilot harness** — a layer that lets one agent runtime direct work across many models instead of being tied to a single one. The idea reframes model choice as a routing decision enterprises can change without rebuilding workflows.

The clearest example ships alongside it: **MAI-Code-1.1-Flash**, Microsoft's small coding model, now runs in production inside GitHub Copilot at about a quarter of the June original's cost, with a 22% gain on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 25% fewer tokens per task. It can also read screenshots and UI mockups.

The more provocative piece is a **3-bit quantized** local build that keeps the full 256K context, matches the full-precision model on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, and runs with zero inference charges on hardware Microsoft sizes above 120GB of RAM — with auto-routing deciding what stays on device versus in the cloud.

zh.title: 微软把 Copilot 调度层做成产品：模型路由与本地量化版 MAI-Code
zh.excerpt: Foundry 与 GitHub 发文将模型路由正式化：MAI-Code-1.1-Flash 以六月版四分之一成本在 Copilot 中运行，并提供 3-bit 本地版。
zh.content:
微软发布由 Foundry 副总裁 Tina Schuchman 与 GitHub CTO Vladimir Fedorov 署名的文章，介绍 **Microsoft Copilot 调度层（harness）**——一个让同一套智能体运行时跨多个模型调度、而非绑定单一模型的层。其要害在于把「选模型」变成企业可随时调整的路由决策，无需重写工作流。

最直观的例子随文发布：**MAI-Code-1.1-Flash** 这一小模型已在 GitHub Copilot 生产环境运行，成本约为 6 月原版的 quarter，Terminal-Bench 2.1 提升 22%、单任务 token 减少 25%，并能读取截图与界面草图。

更具颠覆性的是 **3-bit 量化** 本地版：保留完整 256K 上下文，在 SWE-Bench Verified 与 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上对齐全精度模型，在微软建议 120GB 以上内存的硬件上零推理费用运行——由自动路由决定哪些留在本机、哪些上云。

en.title: ETSI Releases TS 104 275 to Curb Harmful Deepfakes at the Source
en.excerpt: The new specification shifts deepfake defense from after-the-fact detection to lifecycle safeguards, aligning with the EU AI Act.
en.content:
**ETSI** released **TS 104 275** on October 29, a Technical Specification from its Securing Artificial Intelligence committee that aims to reduce the risk of generative AI producing harmful deepfakes. Rather than focusing on detecting fakes after creation, it treats prevention as a security and governance challenge across the AI system's lifecycle.

The spec builds on ETSI's EN 304 223 baseline cybersecurity requirements and supports EU AI Act objectives. It outlines five safeguard stages — risk assessment before deployment, human oversight, misuse controls such as content filtering and AI-content labelling, ongoing monitoring, and evidence-based assessment with test scenarios and pass/fail criteria.

ETSI is one of three bodies officially recognized by the EU as a European Standards Organisation; the move signals regulators pushing accountability earlier, into how generative models are designed.

zh.title: ETSI 发布 TS 104 275：从源头遏制有害深度伪造
zh.excerpt: 新规范把深度伪造防御从事后检测转向全生命周期治理，并与欧盟《AI 法案》目标对齐。
zh.content:
**ETSI**（欧洲电信标准协会）于 10 月 29 日发布 **TS 104 275**，这份由其「人工智能安全」技术委员会制定的技术规范旨在降低生成式 AI 产生有害深度伪造的风险。它不再把重点放在内容生成后的检测，而是将预防视为贯穿 AI 系统全生命周期的安全与治理挑战。

该规范建立在 ETSI 既有 EN 304 223 网络安全基线要求之上，并呼应欧盟《AI 法案》目标。其提出五类保障措施：部署前风险评估、人工监督、内容过滤与 AI 内容标注等滥用防控、持续监测，以及带测试用例与通过/失败判据的循证评估。

ETSI 是欧盟官方认可的三家欧洲标准组织之一；此举意味着监管正把责任前移，落到生成式模型的设计阶段。

en.title: Trump Declares Imported Robots a National-Security Risk, Delays Tariffs 180 Days
en.excerpt: Citing a year-long probe, the White House ordered talks with trading partners and a report in 180 days, keeping tariff option open.
en.content:
On October 28, President Trump declared that imported robotics, industrial machinery and parts pose a threat to U.S. national security under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, but stopped short of immediate tariffs. Instead he ordered the Commerce Department and USTR to negotiate with trading partners and report back within **180 days**.

The probe, opened in September 2025, covered programmable computer-controlled systems, industrial presses, machine tools, autoclaves, industrial ovens, and laser and water-jet cutters. The White House noted the U.S. relies on foreign imports for most such equipment and cited cybersecurity risk.

Tariffs remain a live option: the directive reserves the right to impose duties, quotas or fees depending on how talks unfold. The FCC separately barred new models of Chinese robots and power inverters in July over data-collection concerns.

zh.title: 特朗普认定进口机器人威胁国家安全，暂缓关税 180 天
zh.excerpt: 依据一年期调查，白宫要求与贸易伙伴谈判并在 180 天内提交报告，关税选项保留。
zh.content:
10 月 28 日，美国总统特朗普依据《1962 年贸易扩展法》第 232 条，认定进口机器人、工业机械及其零部件威胁美国国家安全，但暂不立即加征关税，转而指示商务部与贸易代表办公室（USTR）与贸易伙伴谈判，并在 **180 天** 内汇报进展。

这项始于 2025 年 9 月的调查覆盖可编程计算机控制系统、工业冲压设备、机床、高压灭菌设备、工业烤炉，以及激光与水射流切割设备。白宫指出，美国在大多数此类设备上依赖进口，并提及网络安全风险。

关税仍是保留选项：指令明确保留视谈判结果加征关税、配额或费用的权利。美国联邦通信委员会此前于 7 月以数据采集风险为由，禁止进口新型中国机器人与电力逆变器。

en.title: AI RNA-Targeting Drug RP-0172 Enters Phase I in China
en.excerpt: LiboBio closed a near-100M yuan Series A for its AI-discovered small molecules that act on RNA, with a Huntington's candidate now in trials.
en.content:
**LiboBio（砺博生物）** announced a near-**100 million yuan** Series A led by Loyal Valley, Sinovation Ventures' dollar fund and an industrial healthcare fund, with existing backer YuanSheng Venture continuing. The four-year-old firm uses AI to design small-molecule drugs that target RNA rather than proteins.

Its lead pipeline, **RP-0172**, aimed at Huntington's disease, has entered a Phase I clinical trial evaluating safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and food effect in healthy adults. From lab concept to IND, RP-0172 took about three years.

The company's self-built **SSDE AI4S** platform combines RNA 3D-structure prediction, experimental validation and small-molecule screening to narrow candidate compounds. No AI-discovered drug has yet won major regulatory approval, so the trial is an early but real test of the AI-drug-discovery thesis.

zh.title: AI 靶向 RNA 小分子药物 RP-0172 在中国进入 I 期临床
zh.excerpt: 砺博生物完成近亿元 A 轮融资，其用 AI 设计、直接作用于 RNA 的管线 RP-0172 已启动 I 期试验。
zh.content:
**砺博生物** 宣布完成近 **1 亿元人民币** A 轮融资，由正心谷资本、创新工场美元基金及一家产业医疗基金联合领投，老股东元生创投继续加码。这家成立四年的公司用 AI 开发直接靶向 RNA 而非蛋白质的小分子药物。

其进展最快的管线 **RP-0172** 针对亨廷顿舞蹈症，已开展 I 期临床试验，在健康成年受试者中评价单次与多次给药的安全性、耐受性、药代动力学及食物影响。从实验室概念到 IND，RP-0172 仅用约三年。

公司自研的 **SSDE AI4S** 框架结合 RNA 三级结构预测、实验验证与小分子筛选，以缩小候选化合物范围。截至目前，尚无 AI 发现的药物获主流监管批准，因此该试验是对「AI 制药」路线的一次早期而真实的检验。

en.title: Gemini Adds In-Chat File Creation and Editing
en.excerpt: Google lets users generate, preview and edit PDFs, Docs, Sheets, slides and code inside the Gemini app, rolling out to all users.
en.content:
Google announced on October 29 that **Gemini** can now generate, preview and edit files directly inside its app. Supported types include PDF, Google Docs, Google Sheets, slide decks, Markdown, TXT and code; PDF preview and editing work on both web and mobile, while other formats are web-only for now.

Users can expand a document to full screen to type edits, highlight text to ask questions, or have Gemini refine it — for example, selecting a table and asking the model to turn it into a chart. The capability is available to all Gemini users in all supported languages.

The update extends Google's earlier file-generation-and-download feature into true in-app editing, putting Gemini in closer competition with Anthropic's Claude, which shipped similar document and presentation editing inside chat earlier this year.

zh.title: Gemini 新增聊天内文件创建与编辑
zh.excerpt: 谷歌让用户在 Gemini 应用内直接生成、预览并编辑 PDF、文档、表格、幻灯片与代码，已向全体用户开放。
zh.content:
谷歌 10 月 29 日宣布，**Gemini** 现已能在应用内直接生成、预览并编辑文件。支持类型包括 PDF、Google 文档、Google 表格、幻灯片、Markdown、TXT 与代码；PDF 预览与编辑在网页端与移动端均可用，其余格式目前仅限网页端。

用户可将文档展开为全屏模式直接修改，选中文字向 Gemini 提问或让其润色——例如选中一张表格，让模型将其转换为图表。该功能已向所有支持语言区的 Gemini 用户开放。

此次更新把谷歌早先的文件生成与下载能力扩展为真正的应用内编辑，使 Gemini 与 Anthropic 的 Claude 形成更直接的竞争——后者今年早些时候已在对话内推出了类似的文档与演示文稿编辑。

en.title: Researchers Break the Embedded Browsers in Five AI Coding Tools
en.excerpt: Forever Security's EMBRACE shows Cursor, Copilot, Codex, VS Code and Claude Desktop broke basic browser-safety rules; two flaws stay unpatched.
en.content:
Security firm **Forever Security** (researcher Gal Weizman) published **EMBRACE** on October 29, showing the browsers built into five AI coding tools broke three basic browser-safety promises. Cursor let any web page push hidden text into the agent's composer and run a command with one Enter; GitHub Copilot let a page spoof the address bar; Codex, VS Code and Claude Desktop let a local file read the rest of the disk.

The root cause is shared: each tool gave its embedded browser powers a normal browser never has, so untrusted page or file content acquired authority over the agent's environment. Cursor and Copilot were patched (October 1 and 1.1.29 respectively); **Codex and VS Code remained unpatched as of October 29**, while Anthropic accepted a related Claude Desktop report after initial pushback.

Forever's advice: update Cursor and Copilot, and until fixes land, avoid opening untrusted HTML in the built-in browsers of VS Code, Codex or Claude Desktop.

zh.title: 安全研究击穿五款 AI 编程工具的内嵌浏览器
zh.excerpt: Forever Security 的 EMBRACE 显示 Cursor、Copilot、Codex、VS Code 与 Claude Desktop 破坏了浏览器基本安全准则，其中两处漏洞仍未修补。
zh.content:
安全公司 **Forever Security**（研究员 Gal Weizman）于 10 月 29 日发布 **EMBRACE** 研究，显示五款 AI 编程工具内嵌的浏览器破坏了三条基本浏览器安全准则。Cursor 允许任何网页向智能体指令框推送隐藏文本，并一次回车即可执行命令；GitHub Copilot 允许网页伪造地址栏；Codex、VS Code 与 Claude Desktop 则让本地文件可读取整块磁盘。

其共同根源在于：每款工具都给内嵌浏览器赋予了普通浏览器不具备的权限，使不可信的页面或文件内容获得了智能体环境的权威。Cursor 与 Copilot 已修补（分别为 10 月 1 日与 1.1.29 版）；截至 10 月 29 日，**Codex 与 VS Code 仍未修补**，而 Anthropic 在最初拒绝后接受了相关的 Claude Desktop 报告。

Forever 的建议：更新 Cursor 与 Copilot；在补丁落地前，避免在 VS Code、Codex 或 Claude Desktop 的内置浏览器中打开不可信的 HTML 文件。

en.title: Grok Bot Gains Email, X Search and Payments in Push Toward Transactional Agents
en.excerpt: xAI's v0.70.2 gives bots their own inbox, account-free X search and X Money/Stripe Link payments — with human approval gating irreversible actions.
en.content:
xAI shipped **Grok Bot v0.70.2** (changelog dated October 11), adding dedicated email addresses for bots, X search without a linked account, in-chat app cards, and payments via **X Money** or **Stripe Link**. A day later xAI bundled Grok Bot into The X Subscription alongside Grok, Cursor and X Premium.

Bots can now receive email, research public X posts, and — subject to approval controls — make payments. Outbound email and irreversible actions stay as drafts pending user consent by default, though each bot can disable the draft gate, and the terms place human review responsibility on the user.

The release reflects a broader shift from assistants that only advise to agents that can act: xAI's own guidance still tells the Bot to hand the user control for passwords, 2FA and payment confirmation, so approval rules matter as these agents gain financial reach.

zh.title: Grok Bot 新增邮箱、X 搜索与支付，迈向「能办事」的交易型智能体
zh.excerpt: xAI 的 v0.70.2 让 Bot 拥有专属邮箱、免账号 X 搜索，以及通过 X Money / Stripe Link 付款——不可逆操作默认需人工确认。
zh.content:
xAI 发布了 **Grok Bot v0.70.2**（更新日志日期为 10 月 11 日），新增 Bot 专属邮箱地址、免登录账号的 X 搜索、聊天内应用卡片，以及通过 **X Money** 或 **Stripe Link** 付款的能力。次日，xAI 将 Grok Bot 与 Grok、Cursor、X Premium 一同打包进 The X Subscription 订阅。

Bot 现在可以收取邮件、检索公开 X 帖子，并在审批控制下完成付款。发件与不可逆操作默认以草稿形式等待用户同意，但每个 Bot 可关闭草稿审核，条款将人工复核责任归于用户。

这次更新折射出从「只给建议」的助手到「能办事」的智能体的整体迁移：xAI 自身指引仍要求 Bot 在密码、二次验证与付款确认时把控制权交还用户——随着这些智能体获得资金能力，审批规则变得至关重要。
